name: van der Pol oscillator

slots.Xi: voltage and its rate of change: R^2
slots.C: negative resistance of the triode with a cubic characteristic; the injected signal enters as a bias
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of bias
slots.A: mu=1, bias=0; control bias in (-0.5, 0.5); noise D=0.01

provenance: van der Pol, Phil. Mag. 2, 978 (1926); injection of a signal: Adler, Proc. IRE 34, 351 (1946)
loss_law: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)

verdict.stores: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)
verdict.constructs: a single stable state: no write point
verdict.holds: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)
